#!/bin/sh

commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker (sandboxed background service)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventory
Group=inventory
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/inventory-worker.sh
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

# Sandboxing: confine all writes to /var/lib/inventory
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWriteDirectories=/var/lib/inventory
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
sleep 2
sudo systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l
